audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 is fair at 52.35% WR over 2084 games — Karma pokes but has no kill threat; Talon wins every duel stage yet must dodge tether/shield poke and can be peeled in teamfights.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart carried a blanket 'Skill' on all 7 rows while content win[] and packet chart say Talon on all 7.
audit.why: Karma has no hard CC at 1, no ult spike at 6 (Mantra from level 1), and no return kill pressure — Talon owns each stage.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side moved to Talon, whys rewritten to Karma-specific reasons.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and whys[4] name Talon's R 'Shadow Assassin' (real: Shadow Assault). breakdown.cooldowns had no digit. Karma misgendered he/him in 13 fields. Missing interaction: her Mantra-W heals, anti-heal unmentioned in items.
audit.why: Kit: Focused Resolve 12s flat, roots and heals on Mantra; Inspire 10s rank-1 shield changes all-in maths; Mantra 40s and recharges faster as she casts.
audit.corrected: Names, cooldown numbers, pronouns, and an Executioner's clause in report[8].

audit.why: The punishable windows are Focused Resolve's 12s and Inspire's 10s.
